data.description: Boasting a strategic location along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Majan offers residents easy access to key destinations.

data.answer:
Majan Dubailand is a well-planned neighborhood with many green spaces and community facilities, providing a comfortable and convenient living environment. Residents of Majan enjoy a host of amenities, including shopping malls, supermarkets, restaurants, cafes, schools, parks, and recreational facilities.

Majan Dubai location is surrounded by other sub-communities of Dubailand, including Al Barari, Living Legends, and The Villa. It is close to key attractions of the area such as IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village, Dubai Butterfly Garden, and Dubai Miracle Garden.

Various apartments are located in Majan, including studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom configurations. These residential units offer generous living spaces, equipped kitchens, and brightly lit bedrooms. Depending on the layout, certain apartments may include amenities such as a maid’s room, balcony, or powder room.

Commercial real estate options in Majan encompass shops, commercial plots, and mixed-use lands. Most shops are conveniently located on the ground floors of residential buildings, making them ideal for small businesses, cafes, and restaurants. Investors seeking commercial plots or mixed-use land have numerous property options to explore within the area.

Popular Buildings in Majan Dubailand

In Madison Residence, some popular buildings include:

  • Madison Residence Majan
  • Samaya Hotel Apartments Majan
  • Sherena Residence Majan Dubai

Developed by DAMAC Properties, Madison Residence Majan is a low-rise building in Majan Dubailand, featuring studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. There is a gym, rooftop swimming pool, and other amenities in the building.

Samaya Hotel Apartments Majan is a hotel apartment complex in the area that consists of studio and 1-bedroom apartments. Holding a landmark status in the community, it offers amazing views of the IMG Worlds of Adventure and the green surroundings.

Sherena Residence Majan Dubai is a luxury apartment. The units in these three mid-rise buildings are available in studio to 3-bedroom configurations. The project amenities include a sauna, Jacuzzi, gym, and BBQ area.

Off-plan Projects in Majan

Samana Barari Views is one of the upcoming properties in Majan. It will offer a range of studios, as well as 1, 2, and 3-bedroom units with a pool. Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Aras Heights is another off-plan project in the community. It features 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with covered area ranging from 832 sq. ft. to 2,290 sq. ft. Meanwhile, Maya Townhouse by Andalusia Courtyard in Majan will introduce 30 townhouses, available in layouts of 1, 2, and 3 bedrooms.

Properties for Rent in Majan 

There are many options available in Majan apartments for rent. Studio apartments for rent in Majan cost AED 38k per year minimum. The annual rent for 1-bedroom apartments in Majan starts from AED 48k, while 2-bedroom apartments for rent in Majan are available from AED 65k. For renting 3-bedroom apartments in Majan, one has to pay a minimum of AED 90k per year. Commercial properties are also available for rent. The annual rent for shops in Majan starts from AED 25k.

Properties for Sale in Majan

Looking for properties for sale in Majan? The cost of studio flats in Majan starts from AED 390k, while 1-bedroom flats can be purchased anywhere at a starting price of AED 549.9k. Majan has apartments for sale with 2 bedrooms starting from AED 850k. The cost of 3-bedroom flats in Majan is a minimum of AED 1.9M. Prices for commercial plots in Majan begin at AED 3.2M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Majan?

data.answer:
Majan is situated in the northern part of the city, offering residents a tranquil lifestyle. It features an array of modern apartment complexes, where residents enjoy proximity to popular attractions and major highways. Majan Dubailand is one of the most sought-after destinations for apartment buyers in the city.

Public Transportation in Majan Dubailand

There are adequate options available when it comes to public transportation in Majan. You can find buses and taxis easily available near the area. The closest bus stop in Liwan and residents can use car-hailing services anytime to book a taxi.

However, it's worth noting that Dubai continues to invest in expanding its public transportation infrastructure, so residents should stay updated on any new developments or improvements to transportation options in the area.

Supermarkets in Majan

In Majan, residents can access several supermarkets and grocery stores catering to their daily needs. Some of the supermarkets in Majan may include Carrefour Market Majan, a branch of the popular Carrefour supermarket chain that offers a wide range of groceries, fresh produce, household items, and more. Another well-known supermarket chain, Spinneys, also has a branch in Marjan. It provides various products, including fresh produce, bakery items, meats, and pantry staples. West Zone Fresh Supermarket offers various groceries, including fresh fruits and vegetables, meats, dairy products, and household essentials.

Choithrams Majan is a trusted supermarket chain that offers a range of groceries, including international and local products, household items, and personal care products.

Shopping in Majan

Remal Mall features amenities such as a clinic, supermarket, spa, and dining establishments. Midtown Central Majan offers approximately 30 retail outlets and dining venues. Additionally, residents have easy access to Cityland Mall and Dubai Outlet Mall, both just a 14-minute drive away, for further shopping options.

Residents of Majan can shop at Midtown Central and Remal Mall. Midtown Central has many retail outlets and restaurants, while Remal Mall, a relatively smaller shopping center, also has a spa, clinic, supermarket, retail, and dining places.

Schools Near Majan

The Kids Spot Nursery in Al Barari, just minutes away from the vicinity, is a prominent British kindergarten school and nursery in Dubai. It prioritizes fostering children's self-confidence and instilling values and morals. A short 5-minute drive brings one to the Odyssey Nursery in Living Legends, offering a nurturing environment where children can learn, play, and thrive.
For families residing in Majan, the Dunecrest American School presents an outstanding educational option for children. Boasting well-lit classrooms, a purpose-built gym, a swimming pool, and a multipurpose hall, it is conveniently situated just a 3-minute drive from the area. Nearby educational institutions include The Aquila School and Gems FirstPoint School.

GEMS Winchester School Dubailand is 12 minutes away. Focusing on providing a well-rounded education, Winchester Schools offers diverse programs for students from early to secondary levels.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Majan Area 

In Majan Dubailand, residents can find mosques such as Umm Al Qura Masjid and Masjid Hussain Al Bahri. The closest churches, Dubai City Church and St Mary’s Catholic Church are approximately 22 minutes away. Similarly, reaching Guru Nanak Darbar would take about 20 minutes via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311).

Clinics and Hospitals in Majan Dubai

In the Majan community, residents have access to Health Avenue Plus Polyclinic and Dr. Kamkar Medical & Physiotherapy Center. Additionally, nearby clinics include Emirates Clinic and Cosmo Secret Medical Centre. These medical facilities offer a range of healthcare services to cater to the community's needs.

Majan Location & Nearby Areas

Majan is strategically located in Dubai, with easy access to nearby areas. Located in the northern part of the city, Majan enjoys proximity to key destinations such as Dubai Sports City. Known for its sporting facilities, including stadiums and academies, Dubai Sports City is a neighboring area to Majan.

Arabian Ranches offers a serene suburban lifestyle and is located near Majan. Remraam, another nearby residential community, features affordable housing options and convenient amenities. Motor City, home to racing circuits and automotive-themed residential developments, is also near Majan. You can easily commute from Majan to Al Barari, as both areas are nearby.

In Majan, residents and visitors can enjoy various activities and amenities within the community. From shopping at Remal Mall and Midtown Central Majan to dining at various restaurants and cafes, there's something for everyone. Families can explore nearby parks and playgrounds, while fitness enthusiasts can use gyms and sports facilities. Majan also offers access to healthcare services, educational institutions, and religious centers, providing a well-rounded living experience for its res

Restaurants Near Majan Dubai

Meetpoint Restaurant offers a cozy ambiance and a diverse menu featuring international cuisine, making it a perfect spot for casual dining with friends or family. CoCo and Orchid Restaurant, on the other hand, boasts an elegant atmosphere and specializes in Asian fusion dishes, tantalizing taste buds with their unique flavors and culinary creations.

Located in the neighboring community of Al Barari, The Farm offers a sanctuary to reconnect with nature while prioritizing healthy, organic, and locally sourced cuisine—much of which is cultivated in and around the UAE. Indulge in delectable Asian and European fare from diverse menus that evolve with the seasons, complemented by delightful baked goods from the on-site bakery.

For those craving Middle Eastern delights, Jbroz Restaurant stands out with its authentic dishes and welcoming setting. It provides a delightful dining experience for patrons seeking traditional flavors. With a variety of dining options available within the community, residents and visitors alike can indulge in a culinary journey without having to venture far from home.

Beaches Near Majan

Jumeirah Beach is renowned for its array of activities that are suitable for both adults and children. These encompass playgrounds, fitness centers, and designated paths for walking and cycling. Accessing this vibrant beach destination requires a 30-minute drive.

Hotels near the Majan Dubai Area

Samaya Hotel Apartments Majan offers a convenient accommodation option just opposite Majan. Boasting spacious and well-equipped apartments, guests can enjoy a comfortable stay with amenities such as a swimming pool, fitness center, and dining options.

Zaya Al Barari Hotel, situated in the neighboring Al Barari community, provides a luxurious retreat amidst lush greenery. Known for its serene ambiance and upscale facilities, this boutique hotel offers a range of stylish rooms, exquisite dining experiences, and wellness amenities, making it an ideal choice for those seeking tranquility and sophistication.

Premier Inn Dubai Silicon Oasis Hotel is 11 minutes away. It offers modern and affordable accommodation in the vibrant Silicon Oasis area. With comfortable rooms, a rooftop swimming pool, and convenient dining options, this hotel caters to both business and leisure travelers looking for a hassle-free stay in Dubai's tech hub. Al Habtoor Polo Resort is about 15 minutes away from the area. The equestrian-inspired retreat features luxury rooms, suites, and villas offering impeccable services.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Majan Dubailand

Near Majan, residents and visitors can explore a variety of attractions and landmarks that showcase the cultural and recreational offerings of Dubai. Just a short drive away, Dubai Miracle Garden captivates with its stunning floral displays, while Global Village offers a multicultural experience with pavilions representing different countries. For those seeking adventure, IMG Worlds of Adventure, the world's largest indoor theme park, promises thrilling rides and entertainment.

The iconic Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach also provide opportunities for strolls, water sports, and dining with picturesque views. Whether it's experiencing the wonders of nature, indulging in cultural experiences, or seeking adrenaline-pumping activities, Majan's proximity to these attractions ensures there's always something exciting to explore nearby.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Project Fitness and Core Gym in Majan Dubailand offer excellent fitness facilities for residents, catering to their wellness needs. Additionally, many apartment buildings feature designated gyms and play areas tailored for children, ensuring a comprehensive approach to health and leisure within the community.

For grooming and beauty services, residents can conveniently visit VOG Beauty Salon for Ladies, Zava Gents Salon, and Streaks Ladies Salon, all located within Majan. These establishments provide a range of services to meet the diverse grooming preferences of residents, enhancing their overall lifestyle experience. The nearby Al Barari cycling track is also a great option for residents taking care of their well-being.

While Majan Dubailand offers numerous advantages, such as its strategic location and diverse amenities, a few things need to be considered. Note that reliance on private transportation may be necessary due to limited Dubai public transportation options in the area, which could inconvenience those without access to a car. With the announcement of the upcoming Metro Blue Line near Majan in Dubai Silicon Oasis, this issue will be resolved in the future.

How is the transportation infrastructure in Majan?

Majan provides residents with easy access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, making it convenient for residents to travel to other parts of Dubai. However, the Dubai public transportation options, such as buses and metro stations are limited.

What are the housing options available in Majan?

Majan offers a variety of housing options including apartments in different sizes and configurations. Residents can choose from studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom Majan apartments, villas, and townhouses.

Are there schools and educational institutions in Majan?

Yes, there are schools and educational institutions in and around Majan. These include nurseries, schools, and learning centers offering a range of curricula and educational programs.

What are the nearby attractions and landmarks?

Majan is located close to various attractions and landmarks, such as Dubai Miracle Garden, Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure, and Dubai Marina. Residents can explore these attractions for leisure and entertainment.

Is Majan a family-friendly community?

Yes, Majan is considered a family-friendly community with amenities and facilities catering to the needs of families. There are parks, playgrounds, and recreational areas where children can play, and families can spend quality time together.

How to travel from Majan to Al Quoz?

The most convenient way to travel between Majan and Al Quoz is by car. You can take Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) southbound towards Dubai, then exit onto Al Khail Road (E44) heading towards Al Quoz.

How to travel from Majan to Al Khail Mall?

Head south on Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) towards Dubai. Then, take the exit onto Al Khail Road (E44), heading towards Al Khail Mall. Continue on Al Khail Road until you reach the mall, which will be on your right. Follow the signs for Al Khail Mall for precise directions.

What community events and activities are available in Majan?

Majan hosts a variety of community events and activities throughout the year, including festivals, family fun days, fitness classes, and cultural celebrations. These events aim to foster a sense of community and provide entertainment for residents of all ages.

What are the current real estate market trends in Majan?

The real estate market in Majan is experiencing steady growth, with increasing demand for both residential and commercial properties. Property values have been appreciating due to the area's strategic location, modern infrastructure, and the ongoing development of new projects. There is a strong interest in apartments, villas, and retail spaces.

Are there pet-friendly facilities in Majan?

Yes, Majan is a pet-friendly community with several facilities catering to pet owners. These include designated pet parks, walking trails, and pet-friendly cafes. There are also veterinary clinics and pet supply stores conveniently located within the area.

What security and safety measures are in place in Majan?

Majan prioritizes the safety and security of its residents with comprehensive measures including 24/7 security patrols, CCTV surveillance, and secure access points. The community is designed with well-lit streets and public areas, and there are regular safety drills and protocols to ensure a secure living environment.

data.content:
Majan is part of the Dubailand community, offering residents a peaceful, family-friendly environment. In addition to residential properties, the 1.5 million-square-meter neighborhood features commercial, retail and leisure facilities. Tameer Investment Holding and Mozn Real Estate Company developed the mixed-use sub-district Majan Dubai, which is complemented by fountains, ponds, and parks.

The Majan master plan includes residential and commercial properties for sale and rent. The residential units provide residents with excellent amenities away from the hustle and bustle of city life.

The rapidly growing area is strategically positioned on Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, offering convenient access to Dubai's top attractions. The Dubai International Airport is merely an 18-minute drive from Majan Dubailand.
